programmes.d: The conniving Ed Barker murders a rancher and tries to steal the ranch from his widow, Jean Andrews. However, their old friend Cliff Houston appears on the scene to try and save the day.
Framed for a murder he didn't commit, a cowboy hides with a traveling woman as he flees a sheriff and hunts for the real killer.
The Durango Kid (Charles Starrett) bags Mexican-border silver smugglers for Uncle Sam.
A cavalry sergeant (Broderick Crawford) leads soldiers, civilians and an Indian (Johnny Stewart) on a desert trek.
A worthless gold mine leads the Durango Kid and a newspaperman on a trail marked by suspicion and deceit.
An Old West gunfighter (Hal Holbrook) turns a young farmer (Jeff Osterhage) into a justice fighter with a special gun.
Three trappers become scouts for a cavalry captain (Guy Madison) who loses his fort to a hated colonel (Robert Preston).
A cowboy finds himself in serious trouble with a notorious outlaw.
The Durango Kid (Charles Starrett) and his sidekick (Smiley Burnette) catch up to payroll robbers.
The Durango Kid (Charles Starrett) and his sidekick (Smiley Burnette) look for stolen gold with a history.
A Confederate colonel (Richard Widmark) makes a cattleman (William Holden) teach his troops how to herd Union cattle.
A Union major (Charlton Heston) chases Indians to Mexico with a condemned Confederate captain (Richard Harris) and a cavalry of prisoners.
A circa-1917 rancher sends mercenaries (Lee Marvin, Burt Lancaster) to rescue his kidnapped wife (Claudia Cardinale) from a Mexican bandit.
Two old-time Wyoming fur trappers (Charlton Heston, Brian Keith) try to protect a runaway Indian (Victoria Racimo) from her angry ex-mate.
A practical-joking cowboy (Buck Jones) gets serious with outlaws.
